speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia with a functional ovarian cyst (likely corpus luteum). The normal CA-125 and hCG rule out ovarian malignancy and pregnancy, while the thickened endometrial stripe explains the postmenopausal bleeding. Given the normal tumor markers and lack of pain, invasive cancer is unlikely. No further imaging is required; biopsy of the endometrium should be arranged for confirmation.
